phase_origin: Upward crossing of the wave reference level at x = 0.0 m
force_definition: L - L_C01 and D - D_C01; no cycle-mean force subtraction
spread_interpretation: Spread of the displayed cycles, not an uncertainty estimate.
probe_position: Foil reference x = 0, reconstructed from upstream wave measurements

alignment.note: The x = 0 probe was added during a continuation. The full legacy probe history is translated consistently for this display; partial direct measurements are not spliced into it. Acceptance uses its original fixed probe.
alignment.reconstruction: Phase-preserving propagation extrapolation of the measured wave; no force fitting or amplitude rescaling.
alignment.assumption: Measured propagation speed remains applicable between the source probe and target position; local wave distortion is not reconstructed.
